Recycled content claim wording: state the exact percentage of recycled material by mass and whether it is pre- or post-consumer (ISO 14021, CMA Green Claims Code); do not imply the whole product is recycled

Recycled content claims must be backed by a Global Recycled Standard (GRS) or Recycled Claim Standard (RCS) certificate: GRS needs at least 50% recycled content to use the label, RCS at least 5%, and any product claim needs at least 20%

Chain-of-custody evidence for recycled content: a current scope certificate for every supplier in the chain plus a transaction certificate for each shipment; the claim must be removed or reworded when the certificate has expired
